ResFiT_critic_warmup.use: Reference for a distinct critic-only phase. Our Gaussian-policy target and 2000 updates are adaptation choices, not a copied paper optimum.

TD3_delayed_actor.use: Two critic updates per actor update; we preserve the existing SAC target-EMA frequency.

DSRL_noise_dimension.use: Official repeated temporal noise motivates a grouped interpolation, but does not establish that grouped noise preserves pi0.5 performance.

RLT.use: Reuse token-only frozen-prefix training, causally shifted decoder, reference BC, delayed takeover, compact replay, and complete resume sidecar.

RoboDojo.use: Official dustbin training demonstrations; inherited accepted 3-camera/delta-arm/absolute-gripper/quantile-normalization and native simulation adapter.

PyTorch_batch_operations.use: Fused Adam and batched target EMA; deferred scalar metrics reused from the previously accepted DSRL acceleration package. Retain only after production-update timing and numerical comparison.
